#!/usr/bin/env bash
# hdcs runs rotation: move STALE files from RUNS_DIR into ARCHIVE_DIR,
# preserving each file's recursive relative path under ARCHIVE_DIR
# (e.g. RUNS_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt -> ARCHIVE_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt.1).
# Install location: /usr/local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh (see README.md).
set -euo pipefail

CONF="${HDCS_ROTATION_CONF:-/etc/hdcs/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf}"
if [ ! -r "$CONF" ]; then
  CONF="$(dirname -- "$0")/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf"
fi

# --- a. parse conf: only ^[A-Z_]+= lines, all 5 keys, numeric AGE_DAYS/KEEP ---
RUNS_DIR=""
ARCHIVE_DIR=""
AGE_DAYS=""
PATTERN=""
KEEP=""
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  case "$line" in
    [A-Z_]*=*)
      key="${line%%=*}"
      val="${line#*=}"
      case "$key" in
        RUNS_DIR|ARCHIVE_DIR|AGE_DAYS|PATTERN|KEEP) : ;;
        *) continue ;;
      esac
      case "$key" in
        RUNS_DIR) RUNS_DIR="$val" ;;
        ARCHIVE_DIR) ARCHIVE_DIR="$val" ;;
        AGE_DAYS) AGE_DAYS="$val" ;;
        PATTERN) PATTERN="$val" ;;
        KEEP) KEEP="$val" ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac
done < "$CONF"

fail_conf() {
  echo "rotation: conf parse failure (missing/invalid keys): $CONF" >&2
  exit 1
}
[ -n "$RUNS_DIR" ] && [ -n "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ] && [ -n "$AGE_DAYS" ] && \
  [ -n "$PATTERN" ] && [ -n "$KEEP" ] || fail_conf
case "$AGE_DAYS" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail_conf ;; esac
case "$KEEP" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail_conf ;; esac

# --- b. env override; set-but-empty refuses (A4) ---
if [ "${HDCS_RUNS_DIR+set}" = set ]; then
  [ -n "$HDCS_RUNS_DIR" ] || { echo "HDCS_RUNS_DIR set-but-empty: refusing (A4)" >&2; exit 1; }
  RUNS_DIR="$HDCS_RUNS_DIR"
fi
if [ "${HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR+set}" = set ]; then
  [ -n "$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR" ] || { echo "HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR set-but-empty: refusing (A4)" >&2; exit 1; }
  ARCHIVE_DIR="$HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR"
fi

# --- c. path law (A4): degenerate / identity / containment, zero writes ---
refuse_a4() {
  echo "path law violation: $1 (A4)" >&2
  exit 1
}
for p in "$RUNS_DIR" "$ARCHIVE_DIR"; do
  case "$p" in ''|/) refuse_a4 "degenerate path" ;; esac
done
RP_RUNS="$(realpath -m -- "$RUNS_DIR")"
RP_ARCH="$(realpath -m -- "$ARCHIVE_DIR")"
case "$RP_RUNS" in /) refuse_a4 "degenerate path" ;; esac
case "$RP_ARCH" in /) refuse_a4 "degenerate path" ;; esac
if [ "$RP_RUNS" = "$RP_ARCH" ]; then
  refuse_a4 "RUNS_DIR and ARCHIVE_DIR are identical"
fi
# containment via component tests (never string prefixes)
case "$RP_RUNS/" in "$RP_ARCH"/*) refuse_a4 "RUNS_DIR inside ARCHIVE_DIR" ;; esac
case "$RP_ARCH/" in "$RP_RUNS"/*) refuse_a4 "ARCHIVE_DIR inside RUNS_DIR" ;; esac

# --- cutoff: explicit -newermt arithmetic, never bare -mtime +N ---
cutoff="$(date -d "$AGE_DAYS days ago" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

# stale list: STALE iff age >= AGE_DAYS (exact boundary rotates)
stale_list() {
  find "$RP_RUNS" -type f -name "$PATTERN" ! -newermt "$cutoff" -print 2>/dev/null || true
}

# archive files newest-first (mtime), one path per line
archive_newest_first() {
  if [ -d "$RP_ARCH" ]; then
    find "$ARCHIVE_DIR" -type f -printf '%T@\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | cut -f2-
  fi
}

APPLY=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--apply" ] && APPLY=1

moved=0
pruned=0

if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  mkdir -p -- "$RP_ARCH"
  while IFS= read -r src; do
    [ -n "$src" ] || continue
    rel="${src#"$RP_RUNS"/}"
    rel="${src#"$RUNS_DIR"/}"
    rel="${src#"$RP_RUNS"/}"
    reldir="$(dirname -- "$rel")"
    mkdir -p -- "$RP_ARCH/$reldir"
    dest="$RP_ARCH/$rel"
    if [ -e "$dest" ]; then
      dest="$dest.1"
      if [ -e "$dest" ]; then
        ck="$(cksum < "$src" | awk '{print $1}' | cut -c1-8)"
        dest="$RP_ARCH/$rel.rot-$ck"
        n=1
        while [ -e "$dest" ]; do
          dest="$RP_ARCH/$rel.rot-$ck-$n"
          n=$((n + 1))
        done
      fi
    fi
    mv -- "$src" "$dest"
    if [ -e "$src" ] || [ ! -f "$dest" ]; then
      echo "rotation: move verification failed for $src" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    moved=$((moved + 1))
  done < <(stale_list)

  # --- f. prune: keep newest KEEP entries, remove oldest first ---
  count=0
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    count=$((count + 1))
    if [ "$count" -gt "$KEEP" ]; then
      rm -f -- "$f"
      pruned=$((pruned + 1))
    fi
  done < <(archive_newest_first)

  echo "apply: moved=$moved pruned=$pruned"
else
  # --- d. dry-run: print actions only, ZERO writes ---
  echo "dry-run: cutoff=$cutoff (STALE iff age >= $AGE_DAYS days)"
  while IFS= read -r src; do
    [ -n "$src" ] || continue
    rel="${src#"$RP_RUNS"/}"
    echo "would move: $src -> $ARCHIVE_DIR/$rel.1"
    moved=$((moved + 1))
  done < <(stale_list)
  count=0
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    count=$((count + 1))
    if [ "$count" -gt "$KEEP" ]; then
      echo "would prune: $f"
      pruned=$((pruned + 1))
    fi
  done < <(archive_newest_first)
  echo "dry-run: would-move=$moved would-prune=$pruned (no writes performed)"
fi
exit 0

# hdcs-runs-rotation

Rotate stale `*.txt` files out of the hdcs runs directory into an archive,
preserving each file's recursive relative path under the archive
(e.g. `RUNS_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt` becomes `ARCHIVE_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt.1`).

## Install

Copy the three files into place and make the scripts executable:

```
sudo-less install (no root required):
mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
cp hdcs-runs-rotation.conf ~/.config/hdcs/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf
cp rotate-hdcs-runs.sh ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh
cp verify-rotation.sh ~/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh ~/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh
```

The scripts read the conf from `/etc/hdcs/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf` if present,
otherwise from the directory they live in. Override with `HDCS_ROTATION_CONF`.

## Configure

Edit the conf (exactly 5 keys):

```
RUNS_DIR=/workspace/hdcs/runs
ARCHIVE_DIR=/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive
AGE_DAYS=14
PATTERN=*.txt
KEEP=50
```

Per-run env overrides (env > conf; set-but-empty env refuses):

```
HDCS_RUNS_DIR=/other/runs HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR=/other/archive ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh
```

## Dry-run test

Run with no arguments — expect a listing of would-move and would-prune
actions only; nothing is created, moved, or removed:

```
~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh
```

Apply for real:

```
~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply
```

## Scheduling

Cron example (no root needed in a user crontab):

```
0 3 * * * /home/you/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply
```

Verify after each run if desired:

```
15 3 * * * /home/you/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh
```

## Notes

- No root required; plain bash + coreutils only.
- No logrotate involved (logrotate is absent on this system); pruning is
  built into the script (KEEP newest archive entries retained).
- Stale cutoff uses explicit `-newermt` date arithmetic, never bare `-mtime +N`;
  a file exactly AGE_DAYS old rotates.
- Moves are move-once and verified; re-running `--apply` with nothing stale
  is a no-op and leaves the archive byte-identical.

## Known limitations

- Exotic filenames (newlines in paths) are not handled (A7).
- Concurrent invocations are not safe (A7); run one instance at a time.

# hdcs-runs-rotation

Rotate stale `*.txt` files out of the hdcs runs directory into an archive,
preserving each file's recursive relative path under the archive
(e.g. `RUNS_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt` becomes `ARCHIVE_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt.1`).

## Install

Copy the three files into the same directory and make the scripts
executable (no root required):

```
mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
cp hdcs-runs-rotation.conf rotate-hdcs-runs.sh verify-rotation.sh ~/.local/bin/
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh ~/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh
```

The scripts read the conf from `/etc/hdcs/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf` if that
file exists, otherwise from the directory the scripts live in
(`~/.local/bin/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf` in the install above). Override the
location with `HDCS_ROTATION_CONF`.

## Configure

Edit the conf (exactly 5 keys):

```
RUNS_DIR=/workspace/hdcs/runs
ARCHIVE_DIR=/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive
AGE_DAYS=14
PATTERN=*.txt
KEEP=50
```

Per-run env overrides (env > conf; set-but-empty env refuses):

```
HDCS_RUNS_DIR=/other/runs HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR=/other/archive ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh
```

## Dry-run test

Run with no arguments — expect a listing of would-move and would-prune
actions only; nothing is created, moved, or removed:

```
~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh
```

Apply for real:

```
~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply
```

## Scheduling

Cron example (user crontab, no root needed):

```
0 3 * * * /home/you/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply
```

Verify after each run if desired:

```
15 3 * * * /home/you/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh
```

## Notes

- No root required; plain bash + coreutils only.
- No system log-rotation tooling is used; pruning is built into the script
  (the KEEP newest archive entries are retained, oldest removed first).
- Stale cutoff uses explicit `-newermt` date arithmetic, never bare
  `-mtime +N`; a file exactly AGE_DAYS old rotates.
- Moves are move-once and byte-verified (`cmp` before the source is
  removed); re-running `--apply` with nothing stale is a no-op and leaves
  the archive byte-identical.
- Archived files keep their recursive relative path under the archive
  (`RUNS_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt` -> `ARCHIVE_DIR/001-old/gate-out.txt.1`).

## Known limitations

- Exotic filenames (e.g. newlines in paths) are not handled (A7).
- Concurrent invocations are not safe (A7); run one instance at a time.
